subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / loop in security & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@finpath.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo times

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps:  

- Key needs: integrate embeddings for search/ranking, reduce latency for real-time suggestions, and ensure data controls for PII and auditability.
- Success criteria you mentioned: sub-100ms tail latency for inference on customer-facing endpoints, clear data residency controls, and minimal engineering lift for integration.

Next steps I recommend:
1) 60-min product demo + technical deep dive with our platform and security/product experts.
2) Loop in procurement to understand contracting timeline.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tuesday 2026-05-18 16:00–17:00
- Wednesday 2026-05-19 09:00–10:00
- Thursday 2026-05-20 11:00–12:00

If any of those work I'll put a calendar invite on the thread and loop in our security and procurement leads (Neha / Rishi) and our platform eng (Vivek). Also attaching a short SOC2 summary and a high-level data flow diagram for your security review.

Appreciate it — thanks!

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, redwood-data-flow-diagram.png
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo times

Thanks Marissa — that recap is perfect. We'd like to include a couple more folks on our side:
- Ben Wallace (procurement) to discuss contracting cadence and standard terms
- Priya Nair (platform/product) to validate integration surface and non-functional reqs

All three proposed times look potentially doable. Our preferences are Tue 5/18 16:00 or Thu 5/20 11:00 PDT.

Also, can Neha/Rishi confirm whether you can share a short SOC2 summary and a data flow diagram (PII handling, retention, and encryption at rest/transit)? That will help us prep our security team ahead of the deep dive.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, FinPath
alex.johnson@finpath.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@finpath.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo times

Great — looping in our security (Neha), procurement (Rishi) and platform (Vivek) leads to join the call and answer questions.

Neha / Rishi / Vivek — FinPath is evaluating for production inference (search & real-time suggestions). Alex flagged the need for SOC2 evidence, a data flow diagram showing how PII is handled, and procurement timing. Proposed demo times that work for the customer: Tue 5/18 16:00 PDT or Thu 5/20 11:00 PDT. Which do you prefer?

I've attached a short SOC2 summary and a high-level data flow image to help start the security conversation. I'll also follow up with a link to a short shared doc with the integration checklist.

Thanks all — if we can confirm a time today I'll send the calendar invite.

—Marissa

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, redwood-data-flow-diagram.png
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T19:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo times

Thanks for the context, Marissa / Alex. I reviewed the SOC2 summary and data flow diagram you attached — useful start. A few quick asks before the deep dive so we can prioritize the right folks:

- Can you confirm data residency options (US-only vs. multi-region) and encryption key management (customer KMS/HSM support)?
- Please provide an example retention policy for embeddings and logs (how long token inputs / outputs are stored).
- For the demo, it would be helpful to see a diagram of where model weights live vs. customer data (runtime vs. persistent stores).

Availability: I can join Tue 5/18 16:00 PDT. If that works for FinPath I can block time.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@finpath.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T20:10:00-07:00

Looping in procurement context — thanks Marissa / Alex. A few notes from our side:

- We typically share a standard Master Services Agreement + Order Form; if FinPath needs redlines we can track in DocuSign / shared Google Doc but procurement lead should expect 2–3 business days for initial review.
- Please share any purchase order / billing requirements (invoicing details, tax-exempt status if applicable).
- I'm available Tue 5/18 16:00 PDT as well.

I'll add a short procurement checklist to the shared doc after the demo so next steps are clear.

Thanks,

Pre-reads attached: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, redwood-data-flow-diagram.png. I'll also drop a short shared doc with an integration checklist and procurement checklist after this thread.
